name: Faena New York
insider_take: Where Argentine glamour meets Manhattan sophistication in a theatrical masterpiece that redefines luxury hospitality.
whats_special: This ultra-luxe hotel occupies a stunning Art Deco building originally constructed in 1924, completely reimagined by visionary hotelier Alan Faena and Philippe Starck. The property features dramatic red and gold interiors, a cabaret theater hosting world-class performances, and sits in the heart of Manhattan's bustling Midtown district just steps from Times Square and Broadway theaters.
pro_tip: Book dinner at Los Fuegos restaurant before catching a show at the hotel's exclusive Faena Theater - both were designed as immersive experiences that blur the lines between hospitality and performance art.
dont_miss: The breathtaking Cathedral Suite with its soaring 22-foot ceilings and stained glass windows, plus the rooftop terrace offering panoramic views of the Manhattan skyline. The hotel's signature afternoon tea service in the dramatic lobby lounge is a theatrical experience unto itself.
pros: Distinctive avant-garde design by Alan Faena and Philippe Starck
Prime Madison Square Park location in NoMad district
Exceptional dining at Veranda and Casa Faena restaurants
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with unique treatments
cons: Bold artistic design may not appeal to traditional tastes
